walkthrough.title: Tule
walkthrough.text:
Overworld
Note: There are currently no random encounters in the sea.
Sail north past the mountains to trigger a cutscene.
Answer with 'No' to control the ship yourself, then head northwest to find a town.
Go inside.
Tule
Head north to watch the pirates get a drink from the Pub.
Now once you regain control, go east and through the small alley by the Inn to find a barrel.
Search the barrel for 150 Gil. {1/46}
Backtrack to the entrance and go north past the Pub to find some boxes and barrels.
Search the top left box for a Tent. {2/46}
Now search the barrel at the opposite side to find a Potion. {3/46}
Go across the bridge to find Zok's house, but don't head inside yet. Instead, go west around the house to find a secret passage.
Inspect the bush at the top of the house for a Phoenix Down. {4/46}
Now do the same thing but at the east side this time. Search the box at the very top for Leather Shoes. {5/46}
Make your way back to the entrance of the town and head west to find a building.
Go inside.
Greenhorn's Club
Speak to the receptionist and answer with 'Yes'.
Search the pot for a Potion, the barrel for a Phoenix Down, and the box for a Tent. {8/46}
Also, open both chests for an Ether and 100 Gil. [4/225]
Note: Left chest is only reachable through the secret passage shown in the screenshot.
Now go upstairs and open the lone chest on the west side for a Monsters-in-a-box encounter. Don't worry. It's just a Goblin.
After defeating that monstrosity, you will be rewarded with Leather Shoes for such a feat. [5/225]
Don't forget to upgrade your party's equipment.
That concludes all collectibles for this location. However, we're still missing something important in this town so don't leave just yet. Leave the building though.
Tule
Enter the Pub
Tule - Pub
Sit at the stool by the stage to make the dancers dance for you. This will make them get out of the path to the piano (which is our objective).
Go up the stage and play the piano. [Piano Maestro: 1/8]
Note: This step is required for the Piano Maestro achievement.
Optional: Head upstairs and sneak into Faris bedroom to trigger a funny cutscene.
Exit the Pub.
Tule

Feel free to use the bed at the deck below the starting ship to refill HP/MP.
Head east and then immediately south to find a path of rocks.
Jump over the rocks to reach a chest containing Flail. [13/225]
Return the way you came from and continue east to reach a second abandoned ship.
Head north and go through the door.
Ship Graveyard - Sunken Shipwreck
Once inside, go east and take the stairs leading down.
From the stairs, head immediately west and enter the middle room.
Open the chest for a Tent. [14/225]
Exit the room and head back to the stairs.
From here, go south and through the door, then continue southwards to trigger a cutscene.
Enter the water and head west to find a one-tile staircase. Take the stairs down.
The vision here is kinda blurry due to the water effect.
Undead Husk starts appearing from this point on.
Anyway, go west and down the stairs, then interact with the skull box for 990 Gil. {9/46}
Trivia: This item is for some reason not shown in the statistics screen. However, it might be required for completion so better safe than sorry.
Head northwest up the stairs, then go through the north door.
Go west and down the stairs, then open the chest at the bottom for a Phoenix Down. [15/225]
Head back up and exit through the south door.
Back at the previous room, take the south door.
Head south down the stairs and take the one-tile staircase to the next floor.
Go left and around the middle structure to find a chest bottom-right of the stairs. Open it for a Potion. [16/225]
Take the stairs leading up.
Head south and go through the southern door to reach a safe room.
Note: Try to avoid stepping on any of the cracked tiles as they break on contact, returning you to the previous floor... They might not be visible at all, but one of them is just to the left of the southern door (I fell through this one too many times!).
Anyway, as soon as you enter the safe room, you will be greeted with a revealing cutscene.
After regaining control, go through the northeastern door.
This area has a consecrated circle, so save your progress if you desire, and then head up.
Note: You can always rest for free in the room just before the save point.
Mindflusher starts appearing here.
Go up another two sets of stairs to exit the ship.
Head east across the mast, then go south at the split, jump over the rock, and jump onto another ship.
Go through the door.
Pick up the key item 'World Map', which is ironically the same thing as pressing Q → TAB...
Now go east and head down the stairs.
This is a simple room with three whooping treasure chests! Open all for Antidote x2 and Phoenix Down. [19/225]
That's pretty much all collectibles for this place. 8/8 chests and 1 non-counted item.
Make your way back out of the ship, then head east and jump across the rocks to reach one final abandoned ship.
Open the chest at the other side to raise the ship from underwater. This chest is NOT counted as a collectible.
After raising the ship, head north, and before jumping over the rocks, heal up and quick-save as another boss battle is happening really soon.
Once you feel prepared, jump over the rocks!
Immediately as you step on land, a cutscene will take place, followed by the previously mentioned boss fight...

This is a tough battle.
If you have the blue magic 'Flash', this is a good time to make use of it. Ice Commanders' are not resistant against Darkness status and doing that can pretty much null all their devastating physical attacks.
Make your Black Mage (if you have one) spam fire-based spells on Shiva until taking her down. Yes, start with her as she can become extremely annoying with her Blizzara attacks.
As with the White Mage, heal your party on all turns, one by one if possible as healing all at once can be counterproductive if the enemies are focusing on just one of your characters.
The rest of the party can attack with anything you have. Just try to stick to the correct order: Shiva → Ice Commanders.
After winning this difficult fight, you will be rewarded with the powerful summoned monster Shiva!
If you're having issues winning this battle at this time, you can wait until our next visit here to give it another go.
Anyway, now that we're done here, backtrack to the main hall of the castle (walk south of the orb for a shortcut outside the waterfall) and then head into the throne room.
Whatever you do, DON'T free the Lone Wolf as that will get future treasure chests stolen, an action that may void the 'open all treasure chests' achievement...
Watch the scenes to set your next objective!
Exit to the overworld.
Note: We're purposely skipping a section of this dungeon since it's way too hard for this point of the game. We will come back later when we are stronger!

missables.title: Introduction
missables.text:
Self esteem boosterRemember to give it a thumbs up and favorite if it helped you, I need that stuff for self validation :)
Save SlotsUse them. That's it... this section's only purpose is the first -and last- friendly reminder that you have like 20 Save Slots to use as backup.
Also, do try to prioritize the missables over anything else, this will save you headaches having to reload any of the aforementioned backups :)
BestiaryActually open it... No, really
Turns out the Bestiary in the Pixel Remasters is not only an awesome compendium, but actually it basically works as a Pokedex too. It is actually so good that there is no reason for the wiki link[finalfantasy.fandom.com] to be here anymore lol
Do note I am talking about the bestiary that can be accessed from the main menu when opening the game and NOT the in-game bestiary.
Display Map
This is the one feature that makes research obsolete, long story short just chase ? marks if you are planning to complete the Bestiary.
World Monsters: These will show up as a big ? mark, if you go to the location where the mark is you will find a missing entry.
Dungeon Monsters: While a little less precise, it will still show how many entries are in the dungeon and a ? mark for those missing so you know if you have completed it or need to keep running around.
Sidenote: Yes, I figured this out right before completing the Bestiary in FFIV and did not take any screenshots of the ? marks, use your imagination.

Here is my strategy for getting both the titan's axe as well as tinklebell from twintania, took me ~3 minutes per try with a ~6% chance of success (for the tinklebell) per try:
All party members should know blue magic, at least one should know steal (not mug!), ideally one more knows time magic. maxhp from monks can help as well.
Equip them all with a flame ring (aegis and/or elemental shields can work too).
At the beginning of the fight, cast mighty guard to shell the party. if you have time magic, cast hastega as well.
Then don't attack at all (it provokes counters) but instead focus on survival e.g. casting white wind once or twice.
Once the screen flashes and the charge-up message appears, use death claw (has an extremely high success rate during charge up) and try to steal the titan's axe (if the steal works it will always be a titan's axe, its not a rare item).
You have a narrow time window here, so if you have bad luck with the steals cast stop on twintania to prolong that window.
Once the steal is done, wait until the gigaflare hits. afterwards feel free to heal your party a bit.
Now either wait until twintania uses its next ordinary ability or until you notice a short pause in the ATB-chargeup - that is when it changes back into its less vulnerable form (with different item drops). you can verify this change by trying another steal, if it says it doesn't have an item to steal then it is still in the vulnerable form and you have to wait.
Once you are certain it changed, simply hit it with an ordinary attack. due to the deathclaw earlier on it has less than 10 hp and dies easily.
If it didn't drop the tinklebell then load your quicksave and try again.

ludo.title: Tycoon Meterorite
ludo.summary: Follow the path in Final Fantasy V's Tycoon Meteorite to rescue Lenna and Galuf, recruit them to your party, and find a hidden Phoenix Down.
prerequisites: You must have completed the Prologue.
steps: As you enter the Tycoon Meteorite, Bartz will dismount Boko and proceed on foot.
Follow the path until you witness Lenna being harassed by Goblins. Bartz will intervene, initiating a battle against 2 Goblins.
After the fight, Bartz and Lenna introduce themselves. As Lenna prepares to depart, a groan is heard.
Investigate the right side of the Meteorite to discover an amnesiac old man named Galuf.
Lenna reveals her destination is the Wind Shrine, which triggers a memory for Galuf; he is also heading there.
Lenna and Galuf depart, leaving Bartz alone.
Locate a hidden path through trees on the bottom right wall. This leads to a chest containing a Phoenix Down.
Return to Boko by taking the path through the trees on the left and exit the area.
Travel west, then begin heading north. Boko will stop, dismount Bartz, and seemingly convince him to aid Lenna and Galuf before an earthquake occurs.
Proceed north towards the sounds of Lenna and Galuf in distress.
You will be attacked by 2 more Goblins along the way.
Continue north to encounter another pair of Goblins.
After defeating them, you will find Lenna and Galuf collapsed; Boko will help them up.
Keep moving north to escape the danger.
Following a period of rest, Lenna and Galuf awaken and join your party. Proceed north to enter a cave.
tips: The Goblins encountered are Level 6, with 16 HP. They can drop a Leather Cap and have a Potion as a stealable item. They know the Blue Magic ability Goblin Punch.
A hidden path on the bottom right wall leads to a chest containing a Phoenix Down.
Return to Boko via the left side path to leave the Meteorite area.
Reward
Lenna and Galuf join your party. You can obtain a Phoenix Down from a chest.

ludo.title: Prologue
steps: King Tycoon of Tycoon notices something is wrong with the wind. He takes his Wind Drake and flies to the Wind Shrine, instructing his daughter, Lenna, not to follow him.
Meanwhile, the pirate captain Faris, adrift on his ship, observes that the wind has stopped.
An unspecified old man performs an action in an unknown location.
Lenna also notices the wind has ceased and expresses concern for her father.
King Tycoon arrives at the Wind Shrine just as the Crystal shatters.
Bartz is in the woods with his Chocobo, Boko. A meteorite crashes nearby, prompting Bartz to ride Boko to investigate.
Take the Chocobo east to the location of the meteorite crash and enter it. Tips: The events of the Prologue lead directly into the next section,

ludo.title: Prologue (2)
steps: Something is wrong with the wind. King Tycoon takes his Wind Drake and flies to the Wind Shrine, telling his daughter, Lenna, not to follow him.
A pirate ship is adrift in the ocean. The captain, Faris, notices the wind has stopped.
An old man does something... somewhere.
Lenna also notices the wind has stopped and is worried about her father.
King Tycoon gets to the Wind Shrine just in time to see the Crystal shatter.
Bartz is hanging out with his Chocobo, Boko, in the woods. A meteorite crashes nearby and he hops on Boko to check it out.
Take the Chocobo east, to where the Meteorite crashed, and enter.
tips: The events of this prologue set the stage for the main story of Final Fantasy V.
Pay attention to the dialogue and character actions to understand the unfolding events.
Next Section: Tycoon Meterorite

ludo.title: Wind Shrine
ludo.summary: Navigate the Final Fantasy V Wind Shrine to defeat the Wing Raptor boss and obtain new Jobs from the Wind Crystal.
prerequisites: Party consists of Bartz, Lenna, Galuf, and Faris.
steps: On 1F, talk to the people from Tycoon to learn the King is missing and monsters are present. Talk to the man left of the pot for 5 Potions. Examine the pot to restore HP, MP, and status, and revive fallen party members. Proceed to the stairs on the right.

On 2F, find a chest with a Tent on the far left. Enter the middle door to find a save spot. Save your game and proceed through the bottom door. You can take either the left or right stairs to 3F; use the right stairs first.

On 3F, open the chest containing a Leather Cap. Return to 2F and take the left stairs. Go up slightly and find a secret passage through the right wall. Enter the door to find a chest with a Broadsword. Ignore the empty room on the other side of the floor. Approach the large bird to trigger a battle with the Wing Raptor.
After defeating the Wing Raptor (Level 1, 250 HP, weak to nothing, no Blue Magic, can steal Potion), proceed up the stairs to 4F.
On 4F, find a secret passage in the bottom right corner leading to a chest with a Staff. Enter the center door.

In the Crystal Room, examine the large door. After a cutscene (a non-interactive cinematic the game plays automatically), the Wind Crystal shards will grant essences to the party: Faris (Fire/Courage), Lenna (Water/Devotion), Galuf (Earth/Hope), and Bartz (Wind/Passion). King Tycoon will appear, declare you Warriors of Light, and task you with protecting the other Crystals before disappearing. You will receive new Jobs: Knight, Monk, Blue Mage, Thief, Black Mage, and White Mage. It is recommended to equip Jobs like Knight, Thief, White Mage, and Blue Mage initially. Consider equipping the Learning ability (Blue Mage Level 2) and Find Passages (Thief Level 1) as you progress. To maximize learning Blue Magic, equip the Learning ability on all characters and allow them to be hit by the magic. Magic learned or bought is party-wide. Re-equip all characters as equipment is Job-specific. A warp at the back of the room leads outside.

To learn Blue Magic, re-enter the Wind Shrine. Goblin Punch can be learned from Black Goblins (Level 7, 20 HP, weak to nothing, drops Leather Shoes, can steal Potion, uses Goblin Punch). Aero can be learned from Moldwynds (Level 4, 25 HP, weak to Ice, drops nothing, can steal Potion, uses Aero). The character with the Learning ability equipped must be hit by the magic to learn it. Learning these now is not essential as opportunities will arise later.
Exit the shrine, board the ship, and return to Tule.
tips: The pot on 1F restores HP, MP, and status, and revives fallen party members.
The Wing Raptor uses its wings as a shield; attacks during this time will do no damage and trigger a strong counterattack. Wait until it spreads its wings again to attack.
To learn Blue Magic, ensure the character with the Learning ability equipped is targeted by the spell.
Consider equipping the Learning ability on all characters to streamline learning Blue Magic.
Re-equip all characters after obtaining new Jobs, as equipment is Job-dependent.
Reward
Knight, Monk, Blue Mage, Thief, Black Mage, and White Mage Jobs.

ludo.title: Pirates' Hideout
steps: As soon as you get to the entrance, you and the party will dismount Boko. Yeah, sad to leave the chocobo, but we need to go inside.

Once inside, head up and to the left. You'll find a spot where you can enter the water. This is a recovery spring ! Just jumping into the water will restore all your HP, MP, and cure any status ailments. It even revives fallen party members.
This spring is super handy. If you want to grind a few levels, just fight some monsters, then hop in the water to recover. It's a great little spot for it.
When you're done recovering or leveling, head up the stairs to the right to reach 2F.
On 2F, just keep following the path until you run into a pirate. He'll show you how to open a secret door.
Before you do that, though, grab the chest to the left. It's your first chest in this area, and it contains a Leather Cap .
Now, go up to the switch the pirate showed you and examine it. This will open the secret door you saw.
Head up to 3F. As you go, Bartz will spot something outside and run out to see a ship.
You can follow Bartz out through the opening he used, but honestly, it just leads outside with nowhere to go. You *can* save there if you want, but it's not essential.
Instead, keep going through the main path on 3F until you find the stairs to the next floor.
Now you're in the main part of the Pirates' Hideout . The plan here is to steal the pirates' ship!
You'll see a couple of sleeping guards blocking some doors. Don't worry about them for now.
To the left of the entrance, there's another switch. Pressing it opens a secret passage, but you won't be able to get to it until much later, so just make a note of it.
Head out onto the dock and go right, towards the ship.
There's another sleeping pirate and a locked door below deck, but neither of those are accessible right now.
Go to the very top of the ship where the wheel is. Stand above it and examine it to try and steal the ship.
Surprise! Faris and her crew show up. You'll all be taken prisoner and end up behind that locked door below deck.
It turns out Faris and Lenna have matching pendants. Pretty neat!
Faris decides you guys aren't so bad and lets you go, telling her crew to set sail for the Wind Shrine.
You'll learn how the ship can sail without wind – it's pretty cool!
After that, you'll be asked if you want to sail directly to the Wind Shrine. Say No . Trust me on this one.
Faris will then join your party! Awesome! You now have control of the ship and can sail pretty much anywhere.
tips: Don't forget that recovery spring on 1F! It's a lifesaver if you need to heal up quickly or revive fallen party members.
You can fight the monsters here to gain some levels if you feel under-leveled, using the spring to recover between battles.
The monsters in this area are: Steal Bat (Level 2, drops Potion, weak to nothing), Devil Crab (Level 3, drops Potion, weak to Ice), and Stroper (Level 3, drops Potion, weak to nothing).
The chest on 2F contains a Leather Cap, which is a decent early-game helmet.
Remember that switch on the main Hideout floor? It unlocks a path you can't access yet, so don't worry about it for now.
Reward
Faris joins your party.
You gain control of the pirate ship.
Before you head to the Wind Shrine (which is to the north), it's a good idea to sail west and a little north to the Village of Tule. It's a good place to restock and check out the shops.

ludo.title: Tule
tips: Consider fighting outside Tule to earn enough gil to purchase all available spells and gear, as well as extra Potions.
After purchasing items and spells, exit Tule. Faris will rejoin your party; remember to equip her with any new gear.

ludo.title: Tule - Zok is Home
steps: Head to the Pub in Tule.
Stay at the Inn if needed and buy supplies. Consider picking up spells like THUNDER! for your mages and stocking up on Potions.
Visit Zok at his house. He'll claim to have lost the Canal Key.
You'll have a sleepover at Zok's. During the night, Bartz will have a flashback about his father and the crystals.
Zok will give Bartz the Canal Key.
Exit Tule and board your ship.
Sail east towards the Torna Canal entrance.
Before entering the canal, sail south and follow the western coast until you reach a desert area where you can land.
Disembark and head north back to the Pirate's Hideout cave.
tips: Make sure you have at least one copy of essential spells like THUNDER! for your mages.
Stock up on Potions before leaving Tule.
Don't skip the flashback scene; it provides important character development for Bartz.
Reward
Canal Key
After this, you'll see a scene with Lenna discussing the importance of the crystals with Bartz, Galuf, and Faris. It really drives home the stakes of what you're up against.

ludo.title: Torna Canal
ludo.summary: Sail through the Torna Canal in Final Fantasy V, battling sea monsters and preparing for the boss Karlabos before Syldra's sacrifice leads you to the Ship Graveyard.
steps: Examine the door to open it with the Canal Key.
Continue sailing through the Canal.
Monsters will attack your ship as you progress.

Before reaching the narrow passage on the right side of the map, consider your party composition. If you lack a Black Mage, it's advisable to have someone switch jobs for the upcoming boss fight, as Thunder magic is highly effective.

On the other side of the Canal, a whirlpool will appear and pull your ship in, initiating a battle with Karlabos. Boss Battle: Karlabos Strategy: Fighters like Knights, Thieves, or Monks should focus on physical attacks. A Blue Mage can use Aero for decent damage. A Black Mage using Thunder will deal significant damage. Your White Mage should prioritize healing. Karlabos Stats: Level: 5 HP: 650 Steal: Potion Weakness: Lightning After defeating Karlabos, Syldra will sacrifice herself to save the ship from the whirlpool. Without Syldra, the ship can only follow the currents, eventually drifting into the Ship Graveyard.
tips: If you don't have a Black Mage, consider changing a party member's job to Black Mage before the Karlabos fight, as Thunder magic is very effective.
The Black Mage's Thunder attack dealt almost 3 times the damage of the Blue Mage's Aero or the Knight's attack in testing.
Next: Ship Graveyard

ludo.title: Ship Graveyard
ludo.summary: You can rest and heal by going below deck of your ship and entering the room on the right. Examine the bed to rest.
prerequisites: Control ability (for Blue Magic Transfusion, but not required for progression).
steps: Go down the first dock and examine the rock at the end. More rocks will appear, allowing you to jump to a chest containing a Flail.
Return to the main path and go up to find a door leading to SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B1.
Descend the stairs on SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B1 to reach SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B2.
On SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B2, go left and enter the door to find a chest containing a Tent.
Leave the small room and return to the stairs, then head down.
Use the steps on the left to head into the water and find stairs leading down to SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B3.
On SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B3, use the steps to get down to a box with a skull on it and examine it for 990 Gil.
Go up and through the top doorway. This leads to a room with a chest containing a Phoenix Down. To get it, go down the step to the left and walk underneath the upper floor.
Exit the room and go down into the other doorway. As you enter, go down the steps in front of you.
Go under the upper floor to reach stairs to the next floor, SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B4.
On SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B4, go up and grab the chest containing a Potion.
Continue up the stairs.

Return to SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B3 by going down through the doorway. After resting and a story event, go up and enter the door that Lenna went through to change clothes. This leads to a save room and stairs leading up.
Ascend the stairs on SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B2 and then SUNKEN SHIPWRECK B1 to reach the SURFACE.
On the SURFACE, head right and then down. Traverse the water and reach a rock. Examine the rock to jump across, then examine the gap to the right to jump across there as well. Enter the door.
Grab the World Map, then head down the stairs to the right.
Open the three chests containing 2 Antidotes and a Phoenix Down.
Return to the surface and continue to the right side of the wreck. Use the rocks to jump over to a chest. Opening it causes the rest of the wreck to rise out of the water.

Go up and jump onto a rock to reach land. After a series of events, the boss Siren will appear and attack. Boss Battle: Siren Siren has 900 HP. In its human form, it has no weaknesses. In its undead form, it is weak to Fire and can be damaged by the Cure spell cast by a White Mage. Melee fighters like Knight, Monk, and Thief should attack. A White Mage should focus on healing. If you have a Blue Mage, Goblin Punch or attacking are the best options. Initially, Black Mages will be ineffective due to elemental resistance, but once Siren turns undead, Fire spells will be highly effective. Remember to switch tactics if Siren reverts to its human form.
tips: A Black Mage with Fire is useful against the undead creatures found here, despite the presence of a Blue Magic spell that cannot be learned without the Control ability.

The monsters in this area are Skeleton (Level 10, 70 HP, drops Dagger), Calcruthl (Level 10, 75 HP, drops Elixir, steals Potion), Undead Husk (Level 11, 130 HP, drops Elixir, steals Potion/Ether), and Mindflusher (Level 11, 90 HP, drops Flame Scroll).
The Blue Magic spell Transfusion can be learned from the Undead Husk, but requires the Control ability, which is not available until after obtaining the Beastmaster Job.
You can rest and heal at the bed in the room on the right below deck of your ship.
Beds are available for resting throughout the shipwreck.
Reward
Defeating Siren allows you to exit the Ship Graveyard. The chests contain: Flail, Tent, 990 Gil, Phoenix Down x2, Potion, Antidote x2, and the World Map.

ludo.title: Carwen
ludo.summary: Explore Carwen in Final Fantasy V to find hidden items, battle monsters, and stock up on supplies before heading to North Mountain.
prerequisites: Party consists of Bartz, Lenna, Galuf, and Faris.
steps: In the Pub on the 1st floor, examine the top pot in the lower left corner (1) to find 1000 Gil.
To the left of the green-haired girl (who tells you about Walse), examine the 2nd barrel in from the left (2) to find an Antidote.

Go down from the green-haired girl to some boxes. Navigate between the boxes and to the left (under the above level) to reach more boxes. The lowest box (3) contains a Frost Rod. Note that Rods, when used as items in Final Fantasy V, cast a powerful spell (the -aga version for elementals) but then shatter. You must be able to equip Rods to use them as items. Items in Carwen: 1000 Gil, Antidote, Frost Rod.

ludo.title: North Mountain
steps: Entrance: Walk forward and enter the mountain.
Cave A: Go left, then down to a chest containing a Phoenix Down. Return to the entrance, go up and left to another chest containing a Gold Needle. Exit the cave.
Mountain Path A: Go up to find another cave entrance.
Cave B: Follow the path and exit the cave.
Mountain Path B: Cross the bridge, avoiding the purple poison flowers. Continue left to the save room.
Rest Area: Save your game and exit through the left door.

Mountain Path C: You'll be outside again. Lenna will pick up King Tycoon's helmet (a Mythril Helm) and be shot by a poisoned arrow. A chasm opens, and Magissa appears. Faris falls but climbs back up and sends a rope. Magissa attacks.

Boss Fight - Magissa & Forza: Lenna is poisoned; use an Antidote or Poisona. Attack Magissa. She will summon Forza. Defeat Magissa, then focus on Forza. Black magic is less effective; a White Mage should cast Protect. A Blue Mage can use Aero. Fighters should attack. The Ice Rod from Carwen can speed up the fight.

Mountaintop: After defeating the bosses, continue left and enter the next cave. Go up to find Hiryu, the Wind Drake. Lenna crosses poison flowers to get Dragon Grass and gives it to Hiryu. Hiryu heals Lenna's poison and everyone boards him to gain flight.
tips: Avoid the purple flowers on Mountain Path B as they poison the entire party.
For the boss fight, use the Ice Rod if you have it for a quick victory.
White Mages should prioritize casting Protect on party members.
Blue Mages can use Aero for good damage.
If Lenna is poisoned, use an Antidote or Poisona.
The Mythril Helm found on Mountain Path C can be equipped.
Monsters:
021 Rock Slug (Level 11): HP 120. Steal: Potion. Weak: Fire.
022 Gaelicat (Level 12): HP 100. Steal: Potion.
023 Cockatrice (Level 12): HP 100. Steal: Gold Needle.
024 Headstone (Level 12): HP 50. Steal: Silver Specs, Hi-Potion. Weak: Lightning. Blue Magic: Flash (requires Ether to restore MP first).
Bosses:
Magissa (Level 8): HP 650. Blue Magic: Aero.
Forza (Level 8): HP 850.
Items:
Chests: Phoenix Down, Gold Needle.
Extra Item: Mythril Helm (found on Mountain Path C).
Blue Magic:
Flash: Learned from Headstone (requires Ether to restore MP first).
Aero: Learned from Magissa.
Navigation:
Previous: Carwen
Next: Castle Tycoon

ludo.title: Castle Tycoon
steps: Go up and enter the door to the 1st Floor of the castle.
In the middle of the night, Lenna will wake up and go outside, where she'll find Faris. Lenna will call Faris her sister.
In the morning, exit the room and go down the stairs.
There is a Hi-Potion in the rightmost pot on the 1st Floor.
Go up to reach the Throne Room.
Take the right door from the Throne Room to reach the 4th Floor.
On the 4th Floor, grab the Ether from the rightmost pot on the left side.
On the right side of the 4th Floor, collect an Elixir, a Phoenix Down, and a Maiden's Kiss from the three pots.
Go up the stairs to the 5th floor.
Return to the Throne Room and go down back to the 1st Floor.
Go up the stairs on the right side of the 1st floor to reach the library.
Talk to the woman in the library to learn about Lenna's sister, Sarisa.
Collect an Elixir and a Phoenix Down from the barrels on the left side of the library.
Find a Cottage in the barrel on the right side of the library.
Collect an Ether from the pot on the right side of the library.
Return to the 1st floor and go outside.
Go through the opening to the left (down the steps) and enter the door at the end of the path to the Storehouse.
Examine the switch on the back wall of the Storehouse to open a hidden doorway.
At the end of the hidden path, grab the Shuriken and Ashura from the bottom two chests.
Talk to the chancellor, who will give you a Healing Staff.
Collect the Diamond Bell from the last chest.
Go back outside and head to the right side of the castle to find a hidden path leading to the Eastern Tower.
On the 2nd floor of the Eastern Tower, find a chest containing a Cottage in the upper left corner.

Find another chest containing a Cottage in the center of the Storehouse room on the 2nd floor of the Eastern Tower. Chests (3 of 3): Shuriken, Ashura, Diamond Bell Items (9 of 9): Hi-Potion, Ether x2, Elixir x2, Phoenix Down x2, Maiden's Kiss, Cottage Extra Items: Healing Staff, Cottage x2 (from Eastern Tower Storehouse, not counted in main totals)
tips: The weapons found in the Storehouse (Shuriken and Ashura) will be useful later.
The two Cottages found in the Eastern Tower's Storehouse are not included in the overall Chest/Item count for Castle Tycoon.

ludo.title: Tower of Walse
ludo.summary: Navigate the Tower of Walse to shatter the Water Crystal and obtain new jobs, but be aware that the tower becomes inaccessible afterward.
prerequisites: Bartz, Lenna, Galuf, and Faris in your party.
steps: In the area surrounding the Tower of Walse, you will encounter Garula (Level 9, 500 HP). It is weak to Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Water, Poison, Holy, and Wind. It can drop a Maiden's Kiss. You must defeat this passive Garula.
Enter the Tower of Walse. On the 1st floor, soldiers mention Garula attacked them. Examine the door to proceed to the 2nd floor.
Follow the path through the 2nd and 3rd floors to the 4th floor.
On the 4th floor, speak with King Walse. Enter the water to the left of the King and examine the vine-covered pillar to climb to the 5th floor.

On the 5th floor, open the first chest to find a Silk Robe. Drop back down to the 4th floor and take the stairs back up to the 5th floor. Find the save spot. To the right of the save spot, open the second chest for a Maiden's Kiss. Proceed to the next floor.
Continue following the path through the 6th and 7th floors.

On the 8th and 9th floors, you will find three vines. The middle vine leads to nothing. The left vine leads to a chest containing a Silver Armlet; retrieve it and drop back down. Climb the right vine to find another chest containing an Ether and the stairs to the next floor.

In the Crystal Room, an unknown knight is defeated by Garula. Before approaching, ensure you have completed all desired actions within the Tower, as it will become inaccessible after the upcoming boss battle.

Approach the knight and Garula. Garula will attack you. The boss Garula (Level 3, 1200 HP) is not particularly difficult. To make the fight easier, a White Mage can cast Silence, followed by a Blue Mage casting Pond's Chorus. This prevents Garula from casting Toad to cure itself, though Silence will wear off. A Knight with Two-Handed equipped deals significant damage. Monks also deal good damage and counterattack. If your White Mage has time, Protect can help, but healing will likely be a priority. Black Magic deals decent damage regardless of element. A Blue Mage can use Aero for more damage than Black Magic, or cast Flash to make Garula miss frequently. Other jobs should use their strongest attacks or heal with Potions. Garula can steal a Potion or Hi-Potion.
After defeating Garula, the Water Crystal shatters. The unknown knight reveals information about Lord Galuf before dying and mentions protecting the Fire Crystal.
Collect the shards to gain the Time Mage, Mystic Knight, Summoner, Berserker, and Red Mage jobs.

The Tower will begin to sink. A door will open; go through it as the 6th shard cannot be obtained. The peninsula will sink into the ocean. Syldra will rescue you, swallowing you whole and spitting you onto a beach before dying.
You will find yourself near your Wind Drake and the Walse Meteorite, your next destination.
tips: If you obtained 2 or 3 Flame Rods from Ricard Mages and did not get Shiva earlier, these rods will make the Shiva boss battle easier.

Monsters in the Tower of Walse include Elf Toad (Level 13, 160 HP, weak to Ice, can drop a Potion, Blue Magic: Pond's Chorus), Ricard Mage (Level 10, 100 HP, can steal a Rod, can drop a Flame Rod), Wyvern (Level 14, 200 HP, can steal a Mythril Knife, can drop a Potion), and Pas de Seul (Level 14, 280 HP, weak to Lightning, can steal a Potion).
Reward
Time Mage, Mystic Knight, Summoner, Berserker, Red Mage jobs.

ludo.title: Walse & Karnak Meteorites
steps: In the Walse Meteorite, walk forward to find an entrance.
Follow the path inside to a large room with a warp tile in the center.
Step on the warp tile. Bartz will be teleported elsewhere, while Lenna, Galuf, and Faris are knocked away.
Have the other party members try the warp tile one at a time; they will all warp away.
You will end up inside an identical large room with a warp tile, but in a different Meteorite: the Karnak Meteorite.
Walk out of the Karnak Meteorite.
Travel west to the mountains, then follow them north until you can go west again.
After going west, return south. You will eventually reach Karnak town.
tips: The party members for both Meteorites are Bartz, Lenna, Galuf, and Faris.
The journey from the Karnak Meteorite to Karnak town is a long trek.
Next: Karnak

ludo.title: Walse (Town and Castle)
ludo.summary: Explore Walse Town for essential items and shops, then head to Castle Walse to uncover secrets and prepare for a boss fight.
steps: In Walse Town, access the shops: Inn (20 Gil), Potion (40 Gil), Antidote (30 Gil), Eye Drops (20 Gil), Maiden's Kiss (60 Gil), Mallet (50 Gil), Gold Needle (150 Gil), Phoenix Down (1000 Gil), Tent (250 Gil).
Magic shop sells Slow (80 Gil), Regen (100 Gil), Mute (320 Gil), Haste (320 Gil), Chocobo (300 Gil), Sylph (350 Gil), Remora (250 Gil).
Weapon shop sells Battle Axe (650 Gil), Long Sword (480 Gil), Dagger (300 Gil).
Armor shop sells Iron Shield (390 Gil), Iron Helm (350 Gil), Iron Armor (500 Gil), Kenpo Gi (450 Gil), Cotton Robe (300 Gil).
To find the Silver Specs, go left of the Inn, down the drops into the water, a little left, and climb steps to a house. Examine the pot inside.
Leave Walse Town and head for Castle Walse.
Enter Castle Walse. Continue up to the Throne Room.
After the King leaves for the Tower of Walse, return to the 2nd Floor and enter the big door on the right. Go down the stairs on the far right.
In the Storehouse, examine the barrel on the left for a Tent. The box at the top contains 490 Gil. The top barrel on the right contains a Phoenix Down.
Return to the 2nd floor, go up to the 3rd floor, and talk to the scholars.
Return to the 2nd floor room below the Throne Room and go down to the 1st floor.
In the Dungeon, you can talk to prisoners. Do NOT release Lone Wolf.
From the 1st floor, enter the upper door to the basement.
In the basement, RUN from Jackanapes. The left path leads to a chest with an Elven Mantle. The right path leads to pots containing 1000 Gil, Speed (Time magic), and 1000 Gil.
Return to the 1st floor and enter the lower door on the right to go outside.
Follow the path up, into the water, and to the waterfall. Enter the waterfall to reach the Water Tower.
tips: Buy Time and Summon magic if you plan on using the Time Mage or Summoner jobs.
The Elven Mantle found in the basement is a very good accessory.
Jackanapes in the basement are very tough; it is recommended to run from them.
Elf Toads in the Water Tower can teach the Blue Magic spell Pond's Chorus.

Castle Walse: Tent, 490 Gil, Phoenix Down, 1000 Gil x2, Speed (Items)

ludo.title: Karnak
ludo.summary: The town of Karnak is engulfed in flames, preventing access to certain items and shops initially, but events soon lead to your imprisonment and escape from Karnak Castle, unlocking all facilities.
prerequisites: Bartz, Lenna, Galuf, and Faris in the party.
steps: Upon arriving in Karnak town, you'll notice everything is on fire.
There is 1 hidden item in town, but it is currently inaccessible due to the fires.
The Magic Shop is locked.
Do not attempt to buy from the Weapon or Armor shops yet, as prices are inflated and an event will trigger.
Speak to a scholar in the house at the top of town to learn about the monster Crew Dust.
Find the piano in the pub to increase your piano skills.
Attempting to buy from the Weapon or Armor shop will result in you being accused of being with monsters and sent to jail in Karnak Castle.
In your jail cell (B4), an old man named Cid will use explosives to break a hole between cells.
Cid explains he built machines amplifying the Crystals' power. A chancellor arrives, informing Cid the Fire Crystal has cracked and asking for his help.
Cid agrees to help if the heroes do, and the chancellor consents.
Cid and the chancellor leave, and you must find your own way out of Karnak Castle.
On floor B4, you can open jail cell doors, but two chests are blocked by fire. The only path forward is up the stairs.
On floor B3, chests are also blocked by fire; proceed to the next floor.
On floor B2, walk to the bottom and enter the large door.
On floor B1, talk to everyone, then go upstairs.
On the 1st Floor, you can go to the Queen's Chamber, but she is missing and there is nothing else of interest. The other doors and chests are blocked by fire.
Head downstairs to exit the castle.
Outside, a werewolf is scared away by guards using explosives.
Exit the castle and return to Karnak town.
You can now shop at the Armor and Weapon shops with normal prices. The Magic Shop is also unlocked with three vendors.
tips: Monsters in the area around Karnak include Aegir (180 HP, steals Potion, weak to nothing), Zu (850 HP, steals Elixir, weak to nothing), Wild Nakk (95 HP, steals Potion, weak to Fire), and Grass Tortoise (250 HP, steals Turtle Shell, weak to Ice).
The Inn costs 20 Gil.
Potions cost 40 Gil, Antidotes 30 Gil, Eye Drops 20 Gil, Maiden's Kiss 60 Gil, Mallets 50 Gil, Gold Needles 150 Gil, Phoenix Downs 1000 Gil, and Tents 250 Gil.
Before the castle escape, Mythril Knives cost 112 Gil, Mythril Swords 220 Gil, Mythril Hammers 262 Gil, Flame Rods 187 Gil, Frost Rods 187 Gil, Thunder Rods 187 Gil, and Flails 195 Gil.
Before the castle escape, Mythril Shields cost 147 Gil, Mythril Helms 137 Gil, Mythril Armor 175 Gil, Silver Plates 150 Gil, Silk Robes 125 Gil, Mythril Gloves 150 Gil, and Silver Armlets 125 Gil.
After escaping Karnak Castle, Mythril Knives cost 450 Gil, Mythril Swords 880 Gil, Mythril Hammers 1050 Gil, Flame Rods 750 Gil, Frost Rods 750 Gil, Thunder Rods 750 Gil, and Flails 780 Gil.

After escaping Karnak Castle, Mythril Shields cost 590 Gil, Mythril Helms 550 Gil, Plumed Hats 350 Gil, Mythril Armor 700 Gil, Silver Plates 600 Gil, Silk Robes 500 Gil, Mythril Gloves 600 Gil, and Silver Armlets 500 Gil.

After escaping Karnak Castle, White Magic spells include Cura (620 Gil), Raise (700 Gil), Confuse (650 Gil), Silence (280 Gil), Protect (280 Gil), Cure (180 Gil), Libra (80 Gil), and Poisona (90 Gil).

After escaping Karnak Castle, Black Magic spells include Fira (600 Gil), Blizzara (600 Gil), Thundara (600 Gil), Poison (290 Gil), Sleep (300 Gil), Fire (150 Gil), Blizzard (150 Gil), and Thunder (150 Gil).
After escaping Karnak Castle, Time Magic spells include Gravity (620 Gil), Stop (580 Gil), Haste (320 Gil), Mute (320 Gil), Slow (80 Gil), and Regen (100 Gil).
If you did not defeat Shiva earlier, consider purchasing Flame Rods or Fira spells to make the fight easier.
Stocking up on Eye Drops is recommended.
If you need Gil, packs of 5 Wild Nakk near Karnak drop 625 Gil each.
To return to the Karnak Meteorite to fight Shiva again, use the warp tile at the Walse Meteorite.
The Fire-Powered Ship is located a couple of steps below Karnak Castle.
Reward
Access to all shops and vendors in Karnak town.

ludo.title: Fire-Powered Ship
ludo.summary: Navigate the Fire-Powered Ship's engine rooms, solve floor-sliding puzzles, and defeat the boss Liquid Flame in Final Fantasy V.
prerequisites: Access to the Fire-Powered Ship after Cid's request to stop its drain on the Fire Crystal.
steps: Board the Fire-Powered Ship and speak with Cid. Enter the door he indicates.
Below Deck: Proceed down the stairs on the right, then down again on the next floor to use the stairs.

Engine Room Section 1: Go up and enter the door to find chest (1) containing Mythril Gloves. Use the steps on the left, then the stairs in the bottom left corner to reach a small room with chest (2) containing an Elixir. Return. Use the steps in the upper left corner to go down to a chest (3) with a Cottage. On the right side, use the stairs first to find chest (4) with another Elixir. Go back upstairs and use the steps leading up to the door. Enter the elevator and pull the red lever to go up. Exit the elevator, find chest (5) to the right containing a Phoenix Down. Go left and up to another elevator. Press the red switch to go down.

Engine Room Section 2: Go up and use the steps to enter the air duct. Follow the ducts to a ladder going down, then follow more ducts to a ladder going up. Enter the door and use the elevator switch to go up. You will be in a room with 4 chutes and 3 doors.
The leftmost chute (N) returns you to the elevator.

The rightmost chute (Q) drops you in front of another elevator. Enter the air ducts to the right, follow them to chest (6) with a Green Beret. A conveyor belt returns you to the elevator door. Use the elevator to return to the chute room.
The 2nd chute from the right (P) drops you next to chest (7) containing Thief's Gloves. Cross the conveyor belt and retrace your steps to the chute room.

The 2nd chute from the left (O) drops you in front of a door. Go right and use the stairs to reach a corridor with a switch. Hit the switch to open a hidden door containing chest (8) with a Moonring Blade. Return to the door and enter.
The right door leads back to the chute room. The left door leads to a save spot and the door to the next area.

Engine Room Section 3: This section involves sliding floors that do not appear on the minimap (a small map displayed on the HUD (heads-up display — the on-screen icons showing health, ammo and the minimap)).
Go up and hit the first switch (S1) to slide the floor up.
Hit the switch to your left (S2).
Go left of S1 and hit switch (S3) to expand the floor right.
Go to the far right wall and hit both switches (S4) and (S5).
Down and left of S4/S5 are two more switches. Stand right of the top switch (S6) and hit it to move the floor up.
Get chest (9) containing an Elixir. Enter the door to the right.

Engine Room Section 4: You will find the ship's engine and a woman. Prepare your party for the boss fight. Boss: Liquid Flame Party: Bartz, Lenna, Galuf, Faris Chests (9 of 9): Mythril Gloves, Elixir x3, Cottage, Green Beret, Thief's Gloves, Moonring Blade Enemies: 037 Crew Dust (Level 17, HP 240): Steals Potion, Eye Drops. Weak to Ice, Water, Wind. Can use Blue Magic Flash (when alone). 038 Poltergeist (Level 17, HP 240): Steals Hi-Potion. Weak to Water, Wind. 039 Defeater (Level 18, HP 260): Steals Potion. Weak to Ice. 040 Motor Trap (Level 17, HP 240): Steals Ether. Weak to Lightning. Drop: Speed Shake. Hit with Thunder to trigger Self-Destruct. Use Control (Beastmaster ability) to get Missile. Motor Trap only appears if you kill a Defeater last.
tips: For the floor puzzles in Engine Room Section 3, remember that the movable floor sections do not appear on the minimap.

Recommended party for Liquid Flame: A Time Mage with White Magic (if you have Gravity), a Mystic Knight (with Blizzara and Two-Handed if possible), a Black Mage with Time Magic (if you have Blizzara), or another fighter job. A Summoner with Shiva is also useful.
Liquid Flame's weaknesses are Ice, Water, and Wind.
Crew Dust uses Flash when it is the only enemy remaining.
To get the Missile ability from Motor Trap, you must use the Control ability (from the Beastmaster job) or return later.
Reward
Defeating Liquid Flame stops the ship's drain on the Fire Crystal.

ludo.title: Escape from Karnak Castle
ludo.summary: You have 10 minutes until Karnak Castle explodes, with an actual timer counting down. Unlike the GBA version, the timer does not count down on menu or map screens, but it does count down during battles. The timer pauses briefly while you select spells or items, which you can use to your advantage. You cannot return to the Castle once it explodes, so ensure you collect all chests. The Thief ability, Sprint, can increase your movement speed. Failing to exit the Castle before the 10-minute timer expires results in a game over. All random encounters will be either a Sergeant and 3 Cur Nakks, or just a Cur Nakk.
prerequisites: You must have reached Karnak Castle and be in the process of escaping.
steps: You begin on B5 in a save room. Return the way you came and examine the pot (1) for a full restore of HP and MP, and revival of fallen party members.
Save your game and proceed up to B4.
On B4, the fires are gone, allowing access to previously unreachable chests. Enter the first jail cell to the right for chest (2) containing 2000 Gil.
The chest (3) in the upper right cell contains a Monster-in-a-Box. Defeat the Sorcerer and 2 Cur Nakks to receive an Elixir.
Move to the next floor, B3.
On the left side of B3, a Monster-in-a-Box (4) requires you to fight either 2 Sorcerers or a Gigas. The reward is a Ribbon.
On the right side of B3, another Monster-in-a-Box (5) contains a Shuriken after defeating a Gigas. You can also learn Aera and Aero Blue Magic from Gigas encounters here.
Enter the large door in the middle of the top wall to proceed to B2.
There are no items or encounters on B2. Proceed to B1 and go up the stairs.
On the 1st Floor, enter the door to the right to reach the 2nd Floor.
On the 2nd Floor, use the stairs in the upper left corner to reach the top of the Castle.
Follow the path and descend stairs to find chest (6), a Monster-in-a-Box. Defeat the Gigas, Sorcerer, and Cur Nakk (or just a Gigas) for an Elven Mantle.
Return to the 2nd floor room with multiple chests.
Open the two unopened chests for 2000 Gil (7) and another Monster-in-a-Box (8). Defeat the Gigas (or 2 Sorcerers) for an Elixir.
Proceed down to chest (9), another Monster-in-a-Box. Defeat the Gigas for another Elixir.
To the left of chest (9) is a door leading outside to a balcony.
Enter the other door to reach the other side of the 2nd floor.
Upon entering, chest (10) is to your right, a Monster-in-a-Box. Defeat the Sorcerer and 2 Cur Nakks (or a Gigas) for an Elixir.
To the left is chest (11), another Monster-in-a-Box. Defeat the Gigas for another Elixir.
Continue left and go up to two more chests.
Chest (12) is a Monster-in-a-Box. Defeat the Sorcerer and 2 Cur Nakks (or a Gigas) for an Elixir.
Chest (13) contains 2000 Gil.
Use the stairs in the upper right corner. This leads to a Monster-in-a-Box (14), containing a Gigas, Sorcerer, and Cur Nakk (or possibly just a Gigas). Defeat them for a Main Gauche.
Return to the 2nd floor room with all the chests and descend the stairs back to the 1st Floor.
On the 1st Floor, go left and down through the large door.
To the left is a Monster-in-a-Box (15). Defeat the Gigas (or 2 Sorcerers) for the White Magic spell Esuna.
To the right is Monster-in-a-Box (16). Defeat the Sorcerer and 2 Cur Nakks (or a Gigas) for a Lightning Scroll.
Exit through the bottom door and leave the Castle.
Before exiting, you will be attacked by a Sergeant and 3 Cur Nakks. Defeat the Cur Nakks, and the Sergeant will transform into the boss, Iron Claw.
Boss Battle: Iron Claw

Iron Claw has 900 HP. You can steal a Hero Cocktail from it. It is weak to no elements. It can use Death Claw, which can be learned as Blue Magic. Spells like Fira, Blizzara, and Thundara are effective. Shiva is also decent. Attack with your strongest abilities.
After defeating Iron Claw, finish exiting the Castle.
Karnak Castle explodes, and you receive the Jobs Beastmaster, Geomancer, and Ninja from the shards of the Fire Crystal.
Board the Fire-Powered Ship and speak with Cid. He will leave after blaming himself for the Crystal situation.
Return to Karnak.
tips: Use the Thief ability, Sprint, to move faster through the Castle.
If you have time during the Iron Claw fight, try to have a Blue Magic Learner get hit by Death Claw.
The menu and map screens do not advance the 10-minute timer, but battles do. The timer pauses briefly when selecting spells or items.
Ensure all 15 chests are collected before the Castle explodes, as you cannot return.
Reward
Ribbon
Shuriken
Elven Mantle
Esuna (spell)
Lightning Scroll
Main Gauche
2000 Gil x3
Elixir x6
Jobs: Beastmaster, Geomancer, Ninja

ludo.title: Library of the Ancients
steps: Climb the ladder to the door on the 1st Floor.
On the 2nd Floor, examine the pot to the left to restore HP, MP, status, and KO.
Go up the ladder in the middle of the 2nd Floor to the Roof.
Talk to the 2 scholars on the Roof and examine the 3 books. The right book is possessed by Page 32. If you did not learn Aera from the Gigas in Karnak Castle, you can learn it here.
Defeat Page 32 and return to the 1st Floor.
Go through the door in the bottom left corner of the 1st Floor to enter B1 Section 1.
Navigate the shifting bookcases in B1 Section 1. You will need to drop into empty shelves to change the layout between A and B, and eventually reach Layout C.
Climb the ladder to the top of the bookcase in B1 Section 1, walk right, then up. A bookcase will slide to allow passage (back to Layout B).
Go right past the ladder to a dead end; the bookcase will return to its original position (Layout A).
Climb down the ladder and go up. Examine the object sticking out from under the bookcase to reveal the way to the next area (Layout C).
In B1 Section 2, random encounters will occur. Some monsters may call other Pages into battle when defeated.

Learn Blue Magic spells like Level 5 Death from monsters here. For Level 5 Death, the Learner must have a level that is a multiple of 5 (5, 10, 15, 20, etc.) and be hit by the spell. You can also use Control on a Page 64 and have it kill itself with Level 5 Death.
Use the Geomancer's Gaia ability for good damage against Page monsters, but avoid using it on Ifrit.
Head down and to the right in B1 Section 2 to find a chest containing an Ether.
Go to the opening in the bottom wall to continue to the Passage.
In the Passage, head down the ladder to the right, then left to a door and another ladder.
Before the door, climb the ladder and examine the bookcase to open a secret passage.
Enter B2 through the secret passage and follow the path to a room with a book on the floor.
Examine the book in B2 to start a battle with Ifrit (Level 22, 3000 HP).

Ifrit Strategy: Use Blizzara (Black/Red Mages), Shiva (Summoners), Blizzara Spellblade (Mystic Knights), Aqua Breath and Flash (Blue Magic users). Frost Rods can defeat Ifrit in one hit. Avoid using Gaia.
After defeating Ifrit, you can use him with the Summon ability.
Return to the Passage and enter the door.
In B2, a bookshelf will move to block your path but will move once it sees you have Ifrit.
Pass through an empty shelf on the back bookcase to go down a ladder to a chest containing a Ninja Suit.
Go back up the ladder and enter the empty shelf on the back bookcase.
In the Passage Basement, go down the ladder to the right. Skip the opening to the right as it leads to a dead end.
Continue down to a chest containing a Phoenix Down.
Enter the opening to the right, which leads to a walkway. Continue right to another opening.
In B3, walk forward and a bookcase will move to allow passage.
Climb the small ladder in B3 and examine the bookcase to slide the bookcase below you out of the way.
Go down to find an opening in the bottom wall and another small ladder. The opening leads to a dead end.
Climb the ladder and examine the bookcase to reveal a passage after being attacked by a Page 32.
Go through the passage to find a save point.
tips: The Page monsters have the following stats: Page 32 (Level 19, 480 HP, Steals Potion/Green Beret, Drops Potion, Weak to Fire, Blue Magic Aera), Page 48 (Level 20, 500 HP, Steals Potion/Silver Specs, Drops Phoenix Down, Weak to Fire, Blue Magic Level 5 Death), Page 64 (Level 20, 700 HP, Steals Ether, Drops Potion, Weak to Fire, Blue Magic -), Page 128 (Level 21, 900 HP, Steals Hi-Potion/Ninja Suit, Drops Mythril Shield, Weak to Fire, Blue Magic Moon Flute/Off-Guard).
Use Control on a Page 256 (if you have a Beastmaster) to use Off-Guard on the person Learning.
The Geomancer's Gaia ability is effective against Page monsters.
Ifrit is weak to Ice and Water.
If you have a Frost Rod, it can defeat Ifrit in one hit.
Reward
Ifrit (Summonable Esper)
Magic Hammer (Blue Magic from Byblos)
Ether (Chest)
Ninja Suit (Chest)
Phoenix Down (Chest)
Aera (Blue Magic from Page 32)
Level 5 Death (Blue Magic from Page 48)
Moon Flute (Blue Magic from Page 128)
Off-Guard (Blue Magic from Page 128)

ludo.title: Return to Karnak (Follow Mid)
steps: Head to the 2nd floor of the Pub in Karnak to talk to Cid.
Mid will arrive and speak with Cid.
Cid and Mid will depart to fix the Fire-Powered Ship, leaving you in the Pub.
Exit Karnak and travel to the Fire-Powered Ship.
Upon arrival, Cid will send you below deck to rest while they work.
Galuf will have a flashback to his past with his granddaughter, Krile.

Galuf will realize he is not from this world and arrived by warping through a meteorite. He remembers that Exdeath, who was sealed 30 years ago, is awakening and that shattering the Crystals is releasing him.
You will return to the deck of the ship.
Go below deck to find Mid and Cid.
Talk to Cid to wake them up.
Cid and Mid will reveal that the Fire-Powered Ship can now sail without wind or the Fire Crystal.

Cid and Mid will leave for the Library of the Ancients, giving you the ship. Open Ocean Encounters: You can now sail almost everywhere. While sailing, you may encounter the following monsters: Sahagin (Level 20, HP 550): Steals Potion, Drops Potion, Weak to Lightning, Blue Magic Goblin Punch*. Thunder Anemone (Level 21, HP 600): Drops Lightning Scroll. Sea Ibis (Level 19, HP 25): Steals Gold Needle, Drops Gold Needle, Weak to extit{none}. Corbett (Level 29, HP 2800): Steals Trident, Drops Hi-Potion, Weak to Lightning. *Control and use the spell on your Learner.
tips: Sahagins and Thunder Anemones are most common in the central seas.
Sea Ibis are most common in the seas in the southeast corner of the map (around Crescent).
Corbetts are most common in the northeast and southwest corners of the map. Be cautious as they are heavy hitters and can defeat you if you are not careful.
Your next destination is Crescent, located in the southeastern corner of the map and identifiable by its crescent moon shape.

ludo.title: Crescent
ludo.summary: Obtain the Bard and Ranger jobs by helping a Black Chocobo on Crescent Island in Final Fantasy V.
steps: Upon entering Crescent, an earthquake occurs, causing the Fire-Powered Ship to sink.
In the bottom right corner of town, find the Minstrel's House. The Minstrel will teach you the Bard's Song, Mighty March, which cannot be used yet.
Go to the Piano and play a song. This will raise your Piano playing skills.
Talk to the Minstrel again, and he will teach you another Bard's Song, Sinewy Etude, which also cannot be used yet.
Head south to the small forest area, the Black Chocobo Forest.
Walk up to and talk to the Black Chocobo to catch it.
Bartz will attempt to fly with the Chocobo but crash.
Faris will help remove two Crystal shards from the Chocobo's gullet.
You will receive the flying Black Chocobo, which allows travel over low mountains, and get the Bard and Ranger jobs. The Black Chocobo can only land in forests.
If you do not have Shiva, return to Walse Castle to obtain her.
Fly north (and slightly west) to the Wind Shrine using the Black Chocobo.

From the Wind Shrine, travel northwest to a town surrounded by forest and mountains. Monsters on Crescent Island: Doublizard (Level 21, HP 700, Steal: -, Drop: Potion, Weak: Ice, Blue Magic: -) Bio Soldier (Level 18, HP 540, Steal: Battle Axe, War Hammer, Drop: Antidote, Weak: -, Blue Magic: -) Harvester (Level 22, HP 580, Steal: Silver Bow, Drop: Death Sickle, Weak: -, Blue Magic: -) Black Flame (Level 22, HP 220, Steal: Speed Shake, Drop: Speed Shake, Weak: Water, Blue Magic: Dark Spark*) *Can control and use the spell on your Learner. Items available in Crescent: Inn: 10 Gil Potions: 40 Gil Antidotes: 30 Gil Eye Drops: 20 Gil Maiden's Kiss: 60 Gil Mallets: 50 Gil Gold Needles: 150 Gil Phoenix Downs: 1000 Gil Tents: 250 Gil Magic available in Crescent: Fira: 600 Gil Blizzara: 600 Gil Thundara: 600 Gil Poison: 290 Gil Sleep: 300 Gil Fire: 150 Gil Blizzard: 150 Gil Thunder: 150 Gil Weapons available in Crescent: Flame Bow: 2500 Gil Frost Bow: 2500 Gil Thunder Bow: 2500 Gil Silver Harp: 800 Gil Armor available in Crescent: Plumed Hat: 350 Gil Sage's Surplice: 1000 Gil
tips: The Bard's Songs Mighty March and Sinewy Etude are learned in Crescent but cannot be used until later.
If you haven't obtained Shiva from Walse Castle, it is recommended to do so before proceeding, as Ifrit, Flame Rods, and Fira make the battle easier.
The Black Chocobo allows flight over most terrain but can only land in forests.
Reward
Black Chocobo (flight), Bard and Ranger jobs.

ludo.title: Lix
ludo.summary: Visit Lix in Final Fantasy V for a free Inn stay, purchase Ethers for 750 Gil, and learn the Bard's Song ability Alluring Air.
prerequisites: Bartz, Lenna, Galuf, and Faris in the party. Bard's Song ability is required to use Alluring Air.
steps: Stay at the Inn in Lix; it is free.
In the middle of the night, Faris will wake up and find Bartz is gone.
Go outside to find Bartz visiting his mother and father's grave.
If you missed it in the escape from Karnak Castle, you can buy Esuna here for 3000 Gil.
In the upper left corner is Bartz's old house. Someone else lives there now, but you can look around.
Examine the pink music box on the shelf to see a sad flashback.
Talk to the guy who owns the house now; he will comment on the music box melody and then teach you Alluring Air.
Another flashback can be seen if you talk to the guy hanging around near the Weapon/Armor/Item shop.
The Item Shop sells Ethers for 750 Gil and common items at half-price.
The Weapon and Armor shops are on the 2nd floor of the Item Shop.
Exit the town and head due west to find the town of Istory.
tips: The Item Shop sells Ethers for 750 Gil, Potions for 20 Gil, Antidotes for 15 Gil, Eye Drops for 10 Gil, Mallets for 25 Gil, Maiden's Kisses for 30 Gil, Gold Needles for 75 Gil, and Tents for 125 Gil.
The Weapon Shop sells Kunai for 600 Gil and Shurikens for 2500 Gil.
The Weapon Shop also sells Flame Scrolls, Water Scrolls, and Lightning Scrolls for 200 Gil each.
The Armor Shop sells Green Berets for 2500 Gil and Ninja Suits for 3000 Gil.
Buying a few Water Scrolls is suggested as they will come in handy shortly.
You can pick up another Bard Song in the town of Istory, as well as the Black Magic, Toad.
Reward
Alluring Air (Bard's Song ability). Free Inn stay.

ludo.title: Istory
ludo.summary: Explore Istory to find the boss Ramuh and learn useful spells like Toad and Romeo's Ballad.
prerequisites: Party consists of Bartz, Lenna, Galuf, and Faris. Access to the forested area next to Istory.
steps: In the forested area next to Istory, move around until the boss Ramuh appears.
Defeat Ramuh to obtain the Ramuh Summon spell item, which you must use to learn the spell.
In Istory, go left and up from the Armor shop to find a ring of flowers. Walk over each flower tile to make a frog appear, which will drop the Toad spell.
In the upper right corner of town, find the sheep pen. Stand behind the sheep near the left fence line and talk to it; it will kick you over the fence.
Talk to the Minstrel who will teach you Romeo's Ballad. Exit the town by going right, through the trees.
A secret passage exists through the right wall of the Item Shop, though it is not very useful.
tips: To defeat Ramuh, Ninjas (or anyone with the Throw ability) should Throw Water Scrolls. A Ninja Throwing a Shuriken may do more damage but costs more. Black magic users can use Blizzara. White magic users should focus on healing. Spells like Slow, Stop, Gravity, Missile, Romeo's Ballad, and Death Claw can be effective. If you have Dark Spark and Level 5 Death (Blue spells), use Dark Spark to halve Ramuh's level, making him vulnerable to Level 5 Death.
Ramuh's level is 21 and he has 4000 HP. He can Steal Hi-Potion. He is weak to nothing. His Blue Magic is Flash.

The monsters in the area around Istory include Mythril Dragon (Level 16, 600 HP, Steals Potion/Mythril Armor, Drops Mythril Gloves, Weak to none, Blue Magic none), Black Flame (Level 22, 220 HP, Steals Speed Shake, Drops Speed Shake, Weak to Water, Blue Magic Dark Spark), Stone Golem (Level 22, 1000 HP, Steals Gold Needle, Drops Hi-Potion, Weak to Lightning, Blue Magic none), and Mini Dragon (Level 22, 1000 HP, Steals Dragon Fang, Drops none, Weak to none, Blue Magic Transfusion*). *Control and use the spell on your Learner.
If you bought Water Scrolls in Lix, equip the Throw ability or have Ninjas ready. Equipping Silver Specs will help against Ramuh's Flash ability.
Ramuh can be fought at Level 21 with 4000 HP. He can Steal Hi-Potion. He is weak to nothing. His Blue Magic is Flash.
If you are having trouble with Ramuh, you can return later, but he is not very difficult.
The Inn costs 30 Gil.
Items sold in Istory include Potion (40 Gil), Antidote (30 Gil), Eye Drops (20 Gil), Maiden's Kiss (60 Gil), Mallet (50 Gil), Gold Needle (150 Gil), Phoenix Down (1000 Gil), and Tent (250 Gil).
Magic spells sold in Istory include Gravity (620 Gil), Stop (580 Gil), Haste (320 Gil), Mute (320 Gil), Slow (80 Gil), and Regen (100 Gil).

Armor sold in Istory includes Flame Ring (50000 Gil), Coral Ring (50000 Gil), and Angel Ring (50000 Gil). The Flame Ring absorbs fire and protects against frost but is weak against water. The Coral Ring absorbs water and protects against fire but is weak against lightning. The Angel Ring protects against aging and zombification.
The party in Istory can learn Bard's Song (Romeo's Ballad) and Magic (Toad - Black).
Reward
Ramuh Summon spell item.

ludo.title: A Quick Stop at the Library
ludo.summary: Visit the Library of the Ancients in Final Fantasy V to learn about King Tycoon's movements and prepare to travel to Jachol.
prerequisites: Party must consist of Bartz, Lenna, Galuf, and Faris.
steps: Upon entering the Library of the Ancients, Cid and Mid will greet you.
Bartz will inform them that you discovered Crescent Island, but the Fire-Powered Ship has sunk.
Cid and Mid state they will construct another ship.
They will also inform you that King Tycoon was observed in Karnak and subsequently traveled west to the Desert of Shifting Sands.
To proceed, fly your Chocobo directly south from the Library, navigating around high mountains.
Locate the caves and fly southeast from them to a small forest.
Land in the forest and travel west, passing the caves you previously saw.
You will eventually arrive at the town of Jachol.
tips: The Library of the Ancients is located after Istory and before Jachol.
Reward
Information regarding King Tycoon's location and the path to Jachol.

ludo.title: Jachol Cave
ludo.summary: Navigate Jachol Cave in Final Fantasy V to find valuable chests and battle challenging monsters, including the dangerous Skull Eaters.
prerequisites: Party consists of Bartz, Lenna, Galuf, and Faris.
steps: Upon entering Jachol Cave (B1), you will encounter either 006 Nutkins (Level 1, 20 HP, steal Potion, drop Potion) or 057 Skull Eaters (Level 32, 1 HP, steal Tent, drop Elixir).
Warning: Skull Eaters hit very hard and are resistant to most attacks. If a magic attack (including Summons, Black, or Blue Magic) does not kill them, they will multiply.
Consider using the Control ability on Skull Eaters and their Special Technique, Incisor.
A Thrown Shuriken or Scroll can defeat Skull Eaters.
Elemental Rods can also kill Skull Eaters.
Geomancer's Gaia ability may kill (Stalactite) or confuse (Ignus Fatuus) Skull Eaters. If confused, they might use Incisor on themselves.
Berserker attacks can sometimes hit Skull Eaters and kill them.
Skull Eaters are worth 5 ABP each and have a chance to drop an Elixir.
Ignore the skull switch near the entrance on B1 as it does nothing yet.
Proceed down and examine the next skull switch. This closes the cave entrance and moves a wall, allowing passage.
Follow the path to the right.
Go down when you see an opened chest.
In the long corridor, wait for all but one switch to disappear. Use the remaining switch to open the path past the opened chest.
A little past this chest, you will find a closed door and an empty chest.
Examine the empty chest (1) and flip the switch inside to open the door.
On B2, go up until the cave opens.
To the left, find two chests: the left one (2) contains a Tent, and the other (3) contains a Shuriken.
Return right and head up.
At a path split, go down to find another chest (4) containing a Blitz Whip.
Return to the fork and go up.
This leads to a dead end. Walk to the back wall and examine it to climb out of the cave.
The exit is a single square opening in the mountains, sufficient for a Tent or Cottage if healing is needed.
Backtrack to the entrance. On B1, you will need to press a switch to move the wall and then press the switch near the entrance to open it.
Once outside, head east to your Black Chocobo. Fly north to the Library of the Ancients.
The pot on the 2nd Floor of the Library can be used for healing.
When ready, travel west from the Library on foot and follow the mountain path to the Desert of Shifting Sands.
tips: The Blitz Whip chest does not count towards the total number of chests, likely because Lone Wolf will loot it if freed from his cell.
If you need to leave Jachol Cave, the first skull switch you skipped near the entrance can be used to reopen it.
Reward
Tent, Shuriken, Blitz Whip.

ludo.title: Desert of Shifting Sands
steps: Upon entering the desert, walk forward and wade into the shifting sand.
Cid and Mid will appear and explain their plan to use a sandworm to cross the desert, but you must defeat it first. They will ask if you are ready before summoning it.
Boss Fight: Sandworm Level: 18
Weaknesses: None explicitly stated, but susceptible to physical attacks and Aqua Breath.
Counters: Uses Gravity if magic is used or if an empty hole is attacked.
Strategy: If you have the Blue Magic spell Aqua Breath, it can defeat the Sandworm quickly, though it might survive with 1 HP.
If you do not have Aqua Breath, avoid using magic as the Sandworm will counter with Gravity. Black Mages are particularly ineffective.
A recommended party composition is 3 physical attackers and a White or Red Mage for healing.
Wait for the Sandworm to emerge from a hole before attacking to minimize the risk of hitting an empty hole and triggering the Gravity counter.
After defeating the Sandworm, a stable path will appear in the sand.
Follow these steps to navigate the desert: Go to the end of the still sand and step right (A).
From the sand's current, take 2 steps down (B).
Go to the bottom of the still sand and drop into the shifting sand flowing down to the left (C).
Step onto the two-space wide section of sand flowing down to the left (D).
Move left, then a couple of spaces down. Step onto the sand flowing right (E).
This path will lead you between cacti and out of the desert.
Once outside, head south through the mountain path to reach Gohn, the Town of Ruin.

ludo.title: Pirate's Hideout (Checking in on Boko)
ludo.summary: Find Boko at the Pirates' Hideout in Final Fantasy V, collect treasure, and learn the Vampire Blue Magic spell.
prerequisites: Bartz, Lenna, and Galuf must be in the party. Faris will join here.
steps: As you approach the cave opening, Bartz will notice that Boko must have gone into the cave after you.
Inside the cave, you can learn the Blue Magic spell, Vampire, from a Steal Bat (Level 2, 20 HP).
Don't forget the recovery spring is here if you need it.
Make your way through the cave to the Pirates' Hideout.
Talk to the pirates; they will inform you that Boko was injured and they are taking care of him.
The pirate on the left will give you 8 Potions.
Examine the skull switch on the left. You must do this again even if you did it before.
Enter the door in the upper left. This leads to an area with three chests containing a Tent, an Ether, and 300 Gil.
Go back out and enter the other door you can reach.
This leads to where the pirates sleep, and where you will find Boko. A doctor states he will be fine and just needs rest.
Exit through the door on the right to talk to one more pirate.

Exit the cave and return to the ship. Sail north and enter the Torna Canal. Chests (4 of 4): Tent Ether 300 Gil (This includes the 1 Chest you were able to get earlier from the Cave.) Extra Items: Potion x8 Monsters: 002 Steal Bat (Level 2, 20 HP, Steals Potion, Weak to nothing, Blue Magic: Vampire) 003 Devil Crab (Level 3, 16 HP, Steals Potion, Weak to Ice) 004 Stroper (Level 3, 20 HP, Steals Potion)
tips: Remember to check the recovery spring in the cave before proceeding to the Pirates' Hideout.
The skull switch must be activated again to access the treasure chests.
Faris joins your party at the Pirates' Hideout.
Reward
Faris joins the party.
Tent, Ether, 300 Gil, 8 Potions.
Learn Vampire Blue Magic.
